articles.title: Bitcoin was supposed to gain as AI faltered, but it crashed. Here's why.
articles.snippet: The price action runs counter to a crypto-market view that a cooling AI trade would trigger a rotation into digital assets and spark a rally.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $65,000 as Nasdaq closes with 2.5% loss
articles.snippet: Strategy and Strive might be the only buyers left in BTC, and each — constrained by weak stock prices — made only modest purchases last week.

articles.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
articles.snippet: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

articles.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
articles.snippet: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

articles.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
articles.snippet: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.
